unit:root.title: Tokenizer and word-count modules with explicit contract
unit:root.objective: Own the boundary between the tokenizer module and the word-count module and prove the tokenize contract holds end-to-end.

outcomes.statement: tokenizer.js and word-count.js work together through the tokenize(text) contract, each independently tested with node:test.

criteria.statement: Both modules exist with the specified contract, each has its own node:test file, and stage8-probe.js is untouched.

expectedBenefits: Tokenizer and word-count are validated independently before the contract is proven together.
expectedCosts: The tokenize(text) export signature has to stay stable across both modules.

integration.objective: Compose the tokenizer and word-count modules and prove the tokenize(text) contract holds end-to-end.

unit:tokenizer.title: Tokenizer module
unit:tokenizer.objective: Implement src/tokenizer.js exporting tokenize(text), returning an array of lowercase words without punctuation, with its own node:test file.

outcomes.statement: tokenize(text) returns lowercase, punctuation-free words as an array.

criteria.statement: tokenizer.js exports tokenize(text) returning an array of lowercase words without punctuation, verified by its own node:test file.

unit:word-count.title: Word-count module
unit:word-count.objective: Implement src/word-count.js exporting countWords(text), which imports tokenize from tokenizer.js and returns a word-frequency object, with its own node:test file.

outcomes.statement: countWords(text) uses tokenize to build a word-frequency object.

criteria.statement: word-count.js exports countWords(text), imports tokenize from tokenizer.js, and returns an object with the frequency of each word, verified by its own node:test file.

seam:tokenizer-contract.specification: tokenizer.js exports tokenize(text): string[] returning lowercase words with punctuation stripped; word-count.js imports tokenize from tokenizer.js and uses it to build a word-frequency object.

rules: tokenize(text) keeps returning an array of lowercase words with punctuation stripped.
